title: Constraints on phantom codes from automorphism group bounds
summary: Executing a logical quantum circuit fault-tolerantly incurs a large spacetime overhead. Recent work has proposed and investigated phantom codes, defined by the property that every in-block logical $\mathrm{CNOT}$ circuit can be implemented with a physical permutation, a property that has the potential to greatly reduce the depth of compiled circuits. Here we show that phantomness comes at the cost of low encoding rate.
